title: Task Scenarios for Prototype Testing
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting task scenarios for prototype testing to moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Write goal-based scenarios that state a desired end-state and a realistic context, never a click path.
Detect and remove embedded solutions, vocabulary leaks, and other cues that hand the participant the answer.
Define an observable, promptable-free success condition the moderator can score consistently.
Calibrate task difficulty so the design can fail without the task being impossible.
